bias.label: Leaning down below 4,050 after hot CPI

event: US PPI on Fri 13 Nov, likely 15:30 SAST (date from one source, time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Quiet Asian open
bullets.text: Gold was 4,034.80 at 03:23 SAST, up 3.00 (+0.07%) in the new session, holding above Tuesday's 4,012.70 low (Kitco).

bullets.title: Sitting on 4,030
bullets.text: Price is hovering just above the broken 4,030 area, so it has not yet shown buyers are back.

bullets.title: CPI came hot
bullets.text: October CPI rose 0.4% m/m against 0.3% expected, and core rose 0.3% against 0.2% expected (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Hike talk grows
bullets.text: Fed Governor Waller said he would favour a half-point hike if inflation keeps rising, and markets priced about 84-88% odds of a December hike on Tuesday (Trading Economics; figures differ by article).

bullets.title: Dollar firm
bullets.text: The dollar index was near 102.24 on 11 Nov, little changed after Tuesday's jump (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Yields near 5%
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield showed about 4.99%, close to 5%, which weighs on gold (Trading Economics, undated, UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: PPI next
bullets.text: US producer prices on Friday can add to or ease the hike talk (date from one source, UNVERIFIED).

levels.note: Bottom of TradingKey 4,050-4,030 zone; price retesting from above, weak

buy.title: Buy plan (counter-trend): dip that holds 4,000
look: This is counter-trend after a near 3% drop, so use half size.
A wick under 4,000 that closes back above it on the 15M.
The dollar index fading back below 102.
No entry while candles are still long and fast.
watch: Buying at 4,035 because it looks cheap, with no zone and no stop.
There is no confirmed support below 4,000, so a break can run fast.
Fed speakers or Friday's US PPI can add more hike talk and more selling.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection at 4,030-4,053
look: A bounce into 4,049-4,053 that fails, not a sell at 4,035 near the low.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close inside the zone.
The dollar index holding near 102.3 or higher.
Take some profit at 4,030 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Chasing the drop by selling at 4,035, only 22 above the 4,013 low.
After a near 3% fall, short-covering can spike price through 4,062.
US-Iran or other headlines can bring safe-haven buying back fast.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
